subject: English
passage: Many treatises of the Persian mathematician Al-Khwarizmi (9th century CE) are ______ his Kitab al-Jabr, a work on algebraic methods, is an extant text: it remains available today.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it correctly uses a period to separate two independent clauses. The first clause states that many treatises are lost, and the second clause presents a contrasting example of an extant work. 'Conversely' functions as an introductory transitional adverb beginning the second sentence, and the comma after it properly separates it from the main clause that follows.
